text.p: Plea negotiations between Federal prosecutors and former Texaco Inc executive Richard Lundwall have collapsed, and Lundwall may be indicted, the New York Times reported Friday.

An attorney for Lundwall told the paper that talks had ended, and the paper said others with knowledge of the situation believe Lundwall has been told he will be indicted on charges of destroying documents.

Lundwall became a central figure in a race discrimination suit against Texaco after presenting secret tape recordings of company officials belittling minorities and making plans to destroy evidence requested for the lawsuit.
Lundwall had agreed to cooperate with prosecutors in the Texaco case after receiving indications that he would be allowed to plead to a misdemeanor, the report said.
